content: To conduct an automated evaluation, we manually created a dataset with 130 dialog scenarios. We took real first user questions and predefined possible user responses, as well as gold system answers. These scenarios cover most frequent dialogues that we previously saw in human-to-human dialogue data. We tested our system by implementing a self-chatting evaluation bot.
